description: MorphLogo transforms your static logo into a short, looping animated video clip — a ready-to-use branded asset for video intros, outros, social posts, and ads. Built for small business owners and content creators who produce video but don't want to hire a designer or wrestle with animation software, MorphLogo solves the one thing general-purpose AI tools get wrong: it adds motion to your logo without distorting its shape, colors, or recognizability. No redesigns, no endless trial and error. Uplo
